title: Collapse duplicate auth_service assets per section

comments.author: os
comments.text: buildComponentDedupeKey keys asset auth_service components by primary source file (added in 81ad021, #68), so one library detected in N files yields N nodes. Scanning dataPARADE produced 4 identical Passport assets in the backend section (package.json, auth0.strategy.ts, jwt.strategy.ts, auth0.guard.ts). Fix: key on section + normalized name like other assets, keeping distinct auth libraries (e.g. Jwt) separate. Guarding against component recall/precision regression with the four-layer scorecard, since #68 tied the per-file key to those numbers.

comments.author: home
